independent_computation.step_1_scenario_gating: The scenario suffix '120' is the Splinters of Wrath option value. Cached wiki text (P) caps Splinters at 120 and grants Transcendence (+15% AP) exactly there, so at 120 every Transcendent threshold is satisfied: Q's 40-splinter threshold, W's 60-splinter threshold, and P's 120-splinter capstone.
independent_computation.step_2_q_is_a_charged_ability_at_120: Q's cached wiki text: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' Q also carries rechargeRate [7,7,7,7,7] (a recharge/ammo field, non-null only for Q among Syndra's five slots; W/E/R are null). Therefore at 120 splinters Syndra can cast Dark Sphere twice back-to-back off two stocked charges, and the second cast is a legitimate, distinct entry in a cast timeline.
independent_computation.step_3_the_module_slot_list: The cached audit records Syndra's modeled cast slots as the ordered list ['P','Q','Q2','W','E','R'], with the explicit note that Q2 is the 'synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)' slot introduced for the 40+ splinter charge. A custom cast order for Syndra at 120 splinters therefore has Q2 available as the cast immediately following Q, i.e. at timeline index 1 (0-based) of a Q -> Q2 -> ... order.
independent_computation.step_4_diagnosis_of_the_old_value: The cached source ability table has only five slots, in order ['P','Q','W','E','R'] -> ['Transcendent','Dark Sphere','Force of Will','Scatter the Weak','Unleashed Power']. The module slot list ['P','Q','Q2','W','E','R'] inserts the synthetic Q2 as its third entry. Resolving the display name of the third module slot positionally against the five-entry wiki table yields the third wiki ability, W = 'Force of Will'. The old value is exactly this off-by-one product: the Q2 slot borrowing W's name. It is not a physically different rotation, it is the synthetic charge slot mislabelled.
independent_computation.step_5_what_the_name_should_be: The cast at index 1 is a second Dark Sphere fired from a stocked charge. The wiki names the ability 'Dark Sphere' and names the mechanic a 'Dark Sphere charge ... up to a maximum of 2'. The faithful label is therefore 'Dark Sphere' qualified as the second charge -> 'Dark Sphere (2nd charge)'. It cannot be 'Force of Will': W is a grab-and-throw with its own separate damage row (70/100/130/160/190 + 65% AP, plus the 60-splinter 12% + 2% per 100 AP bonus true damage), whereas Q is 90/125/160/195/230 + 70% AP magic damage. The two are different abilities with different scalings, so the label 'Force of Will' on a Dark Sphere charge cast is unambiguously wrong.
independent_computation.step_6_sanity_on_damage_rows: Cross-check that the mislabelled entry was a Q and not really a W: Q wiki damage = 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP); W wiki recast damage = 70/100/130/160/190 (+65% AP) with, at >=60 splinters, an added 12% (+2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage component that Q has no analogue for. Q and W are also distinguished by cooldown behaviour in the cache: Q cooldown 7s flat with affectedByCdr=false and a non-null rechargeRate, W cooldown 12/11/10/9/8 with affectedByCdr=true and rechargeRate null. Only the Q family can produce two consecutive casts from stocked charges, which is precisely what a 120-splinter custom-order scenario exists to exercise.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario's literal cast-order list lives outside the sealed evidence tree (scripts/ and tests/ were deliberately not read). The conclusion rests on: (a) cached wiki text making a second stocked Dark Sphere the only charge-driven repeat cast Syndra has, (b) the cached audit recording 'Q2' as a real synthetic slot sitting between Q and W in the module's slot order, and (c) the old value 'Force of Will' being the exact string an unaware positional lookup of that Q2 slot against the five-entry wiki ability table returns. Under any custom order in which index 1 is the Q2 slot -- the only order the '120' gating makes interesting -- 'Dark Sphere (2nd charge)' is correct and 'Force of Will' is a mislabel.
